title: Q17 Sequence of statements on River Ganga importance
subject: Geography
caption: Flowchart showing the logical sequence of statements P‑S and their linked cultural, ecological, and economic significance for the River Ganga.
altText: A top-to-bottom flowchart begins with a Start node, proceeds through four statement nodes labeled P, Q, R, S in that order, and ends at an End node. Statement P and Q both point to a Cultural Significance node, statement R points to an Ecological Significance node, and statement S points to an Economic Significance node, illustrating how each statement relates to a specific aspect of the Ganga's importance.
